messages:
Maya: Big shoutout to @Devon — stayed late and found the weird packaging issue that broke the nightly build. also brought in a surprise sourdough for the on-call crew :bread: :tada:
Sam: omg that sourdough was unreal. more importantly — Devon tracked down the missing `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` tweak that fixed the agent crash. absolute legend.
Devon: nah it was a team effort. Rachel had the killer grep-fu at 2am and pointed me to the right logs :coffee:
Rachel: sleepy but proud. I swear the logs looked like a poem. also props to whatever script autopushed the rollback — saved us from a bad morning.
Sam: can we put a tiny prize in the next all-hands for night-shift rescue heroes? i volunteer to run the tiny trophies.
Maya: adding to all-hands agenda +1. also ordering breakfast for tomorrow — sourdough round two? poll: yes/no
Devon: yes please :pray: (i will graciously accept more carbs)
Rachel: yes + croissants? :croissant:
DeployBot: Deployment 2023.11.01-42 rolled back automatically at 01:12 UTC due to spec mismatch. Trigger: healthcheck fail.
Sam: thanks @DeployBot for the receipts. official kudos to the night crew — will send a snack card and a big virtual :clap: in team channel.
Maya: Devon — can you paste the quickfix command here so ops can add it to the runbook?
Devon: sure: `export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH && systemctl restart redwood-agent`
Rachel: copied to #runbook and opened a tiny follow-up issue with steps + test case.
Maya: perfect. thanks again everyone — seriously saved the demo tomorrow. heart emojis all around :heart:
